streaming.band_scope: clean channel; band_by_channel carries the rest

operating_point.headline: On the unseen 2025 cloner the shipped band calls 69.2% synthetic, defers on 0.0% and waves 30.8% through, even though its ranking EER is 5.7%. Ranking transfers to a new generator; the absolute threshold does not. This is why a high-value action always requires the device factor.

band_selection.selection_note: Every budget from 0.002 to 0.05 clears the bar and every one of them measures the same worst-channel false-positive rate, 0.79% on g723_1_6k3, because the isotonic calibrator emits a handful of discrete steps and the whole grid lands between the same two of them on the test split. The budget is therefore NOT identified by this sweep. Pramaan ships 0.02, which sits inside that flat region; it is a declared design choice, not a fit, and the sweep is published so a reader can see it was not tuned to a result.
band_selection.head_trained_on: train split only, so the selection never sees test clips

generator_matrix_note: Each row trains on CLEAN audio only and is then scored through every codec, so the per-condition fpr_at_p50 here measures a clean-trained head meeting an unseen channel at a fixed 0.5 threshold. It is a channel-shift stress test, not the shipped system: the shipped head in `ship` trains on all seven conditions and decides at the per-channel band in `streaming.band_by_channel`. Compare against operating_point.per_channel_genuine, never against this row.

clip_count_reconciliation.resolved: Both counts are correct and they belong to different protocols. 39 is every Chatterbox clip in the corpus (dataset.by_generator.chatterbox), and the shipped head never trains on any of them, so all 39 are held out at the operating point. 23 is the subset that falls in the 25% test split of parent recordings, which is what the leave-one-generator-out headline is scored on, because that protocol also needs its genuine side held out from the head's training split. The headline EER is an EER over 23 clones and 127 genuine recordings, and that is the pair of counts any interval on it must use.

replay_mic.headline: Playing audio through a loudspeaker into a microphone costs the detector real accuracy. With the channel held out of training, EER on replay_mic is 18.2% (95% CI 10.0% to 25.2%), and at the g723_1_6k3 fallback band 75.5% of clones played through a speaker are called synthetic while 14.0% of genuine speech through the same speaker is called synthetic too, which is the larger of the two problems and is far above the 0.9% this system reports on the telephony grid. The shipped head scores better on these clips because it trains on them, so its number is in sample and is labelled as such rather than quoted as generalisation. This is published rather than hidden, it is why docs/RUNSHEET.md records that the Chatterbox clone through the microphone reads as human, and it is the beat where the device push does the blocking instead of the detector.

adversarial_malafide.variant: BLACK BOX. Random short FIR filters, worst case over the bank. The published attack optimises the filter against the countermeasure with gradients; this does not. Every number here is therefore a LOWER BOUND on the damage the published attack would do.
adversarial_malafide.applied_to: held-out spoof clips only. Genuine speech is never filtered, because an attacker controls their own synthetic audio and not the victim's microphone.
adversarial_malafide.detector: the shipped bundle, not retrained, not refit, not recalibrated
unmeasured: white-box gradient attack against this system
adversarial training as a defence, which needs gradients through a 300M-parameter frozen frontend and is a GPU workload
the attack against the Gate's sequential decision rather than against a single 4 s score
adversarial_malafide.headline: The attack does not land. Across all 9 filters, 129 to 513 taps at 0.05 to 0.35 off-centre energy, held-out EER on 505 seen-family spoof clips stays at 0.00% against 0.00% before the attack, and the share of clones called synthetic at the shipped band stays at 100.0% against 100.0% before, on every filter including the most aggressive one at a median signal-to-distortion of 9.3 dB, where the colouration is audible. Under that filter the median spoof score moves +0.508 in log-odds, towards synthetic rather than away from it, so the filter is adding evidence for the detector instead of removing it. This is the weak version of the attack. The published Malafide optimises the filter against the detector with gradients and would do more. A white-box gradient attack against the frozen XLS-R frontend remains unmeasured, and adversarial training is out of scope on this hardware, because it needs gradients through a 300M-parameter frontend and there is no GPU for it.

summary.note: Every direction trains its own head on the other trained families and is replayed against held-out genuine speech, so no row here is in sample. The clean channel is the only one where every direction is measurable: on the six codec channels the held-out family is cached at 4.0 s alone for every family except xtts_v2 and freevc24, and the Gate needs three updates at or above 1.5 s before it may commit, so 42 of 63 cells cannot commit on the held-out clones for a cache reason. Their genuine halves are still measured and their false-alarm rates still count.
